{{Quote|The Despot Army was defeated at Kaleth, the Temple of Knowledge. Queen Hadiya was slain. But every victory comes at a cost. Many Je'daii warriors fell in that battle. Many more of the Despot's Army died.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DOTJ1" />}}
The '''Battle of Tython''', also known as the '''Battle of Kaleth''', was the final battle of the [[Despot War]] which was waged by [[Despot Queen]] [[Hadiya]] against the [[Je'daii Order]] in [[25,805 BBY]].

==Overview==
Believing that the Je'daii were a fraudulent organization keeping a thumb over the lives of the citizens of the [[Settled Worlds]], [[Hadiya]] of [[Shikaakwa]] led a war of conquest which sought to unite the worlds of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] against the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] itself. Amassing a [[Despot Army|huge army]], Hadiya led her forces in battle against the Je'daii on Tython. While possessing great numbers, the Despot army could not withstand the Je'daii's mastery over [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DOTJ1" /> During the fighting, [[Pho-V fighter]] were used against the Je'daii and many were shot down over the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Bogan]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>

When the fighting came to [[Kaleth]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Je'daii Temple]] of Knowledge, Hadiya and one of her top generals, the fallen Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]] led from the front line and slew many Je'daii warriors.<ref name="DOTJ10" /> Crossing blades with a [[Shae Koda's father|pair]] of [[Shae Koda's mother|Human Je'daii]], Hadiya killed them in battle.<ref name="DOTJ4" /> During the campaign, Hadiya was deep in sleep when her lover and alleged ally, Daegen Lok, revealed himself to be a Je'daii mole. Using the Force, Lok assassinated his queen and the fighting ended as Hadiya's factions broke into a scramble for power.<ref name="DOTJ10" /> By the end of the conflict, Kaleth had sustained structural damage to one of its towers and many Je'daii had died.<ref name="DOTJ1" />
